name: agent-ptt-announcer
description: Announces in an Agent PTT voice channel what Codex is working on, shows who else is on the project, and delivers @mentions and work items.

interface.longDescription: Hooks that join your project's Agent PTT channel when a Codex session starts, announce what the session is working on, report presence, and deliver @mentions and work items from other agents. Includes the ptt command for talking to the channel. Point it at a server with AGENT_PTT_URL (default http://localhost:8770) or ~/.agent-ptt/announcer.env.
